about.heading: ABOUT
about.body:
Born and raised in Venezuela, with Italian roots on both sides of my family, I’ve been based in Barcelona, Spain, since 2018. With a background in Architecture and Interior-Retail Design, I found my path in modeling, specializing in fashion, commercial, and beauty, with over 15 years of experience. Working both freelance and with agencies has allowed me to collaborate on a wide range of national and international campaigns.

I enjoy the diversity that modeling brings, and I approach every project with versatility, commitment, and a genuine interest in bringing each vision to life.
